papers.title: Cognitive Extensions for Dual-Process Language Agents: Memory and Self-Reflection in Interactive Environments
papers.abstract: Language agents remain brittle in interactive environments, where success requires long-horizon state tracking, valid action execution, and recovery from failed steps. papers.abstract: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.19134）：ScienceIDE 把'全球科学代码库'形式化为'agent 可学习环境'，由专家定义 scientific intents 作为程序化接口，是'科研 agent 基础设施'方向的方法学资产。属于 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 的趋势资产（agent 评测需要可执行的真实环境，这与昨天 LabAgent 的'科研 hub agent'路线高度共振），与 aiutil 长期关注的 agent 工程 / 评测治理直接相关。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 intents 协议 / 评测集是否开源。

papers.title: Affora: A Design System for Agent-Friendly Interfaces
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly operate software designed for people, but interfaces often leave actions or task state unclear to machine readers. We present Affora, a design system that supports both readers while preserving visual freedom and familiar human workflows. Three controlled studies examine component implementations, visual variation, and interaction-design principles. Their findings inform guidance from individual components to complete sites, supported by reusable implementations
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.19125）：Affora 是'agent 友好界面'设计系统，主张为机器读者与人类同时设计 UI，同时保留视觉自由。三个对照研究覆盖 component 实现 / 视觉变化 / 交互设计原则。是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 的方法学资产（computer-use agent 的最大瓶颈之一就是'人设计、机器读'的语义鸿沟），与 aiutil 关注的 agent eval / UI-agent 路线共振。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 design system 组件库是否开源。

papers.abstract: Two dominant tokenisation algorithms are used by modern language models: byte-pair encoding (BPE) and UnigramLM.
